title: Inside the Fight Against a Flesh-Eating Fly in Mexico
summary_full: For the first time in a year, the U.S.-Mexico border partly reopened to cattle imports following a screwworm infestation across the region. The battle against the flesh-eating fly has only just begun deep in Mexico.
